title: Just better build
description: Modpack for building in creative mode
body:
A lightweight **client-side modpack**. No new blocks, no new mobs, no new worldgen. Just pure improvements to how you build.

It gives you better tools, smoother controls, and smarter helpers. Copy and paste structures, work with easier placements, manage your inventory faster, and see your builds with enhanced visuals.

Everything is designed to remove the small frustrations and let you focus on the creative part. Install it on top of your favorite world or server.
